### 2.4.0 (2026-10-18)

- Added to index.json: `cite.api`, the citation of the API release (`title`, `version`, `url`, `release_url`, `doi`, `apa`, `bibtex`, `csl_json`). `url` is the pinned address of the release, `/api/<release>/index.json`; `doi` is null until Zenodo mints one for the release.
- Added to cases/{id}.json: `citation`, the Zenodo dataset of the case as `apa` and `bibtex`.
- Added to the `stats` of geometry.json and to the entries of the geometry index: `bodies`, `body_contacts`, `inconsistent_triangles` and `min_body_volume`, beside `edges_boundary`. `watertight` is true when every body is closed, consistently wound and positive in volume.
- Changed: the `geometry.stl` of Cases E, F and M. Every body is a closed, consistently wound, outward body; Cases F and M stand on a 1 m base slab, so the bounding box of each starts at z = -1 m, and `triangles` and `data_version` change with the files.
- Added: the layout figure of each case, `case-<id>-layout.png`, is the first entry of `figures` of the validation results of that case (Cases A to M); the agreement figures colour their points by the groups of that figure.

### 2.3.0 (2026-10-18)

- Added: release-numbered paths. Every release is a frozen copy of the whole API under `/api/<release>/` (for example `/api/3.0.0/index.json`, `/api/3.0.0/cases/F.json`). Every URL to a file of the API inside a copy points into the same copy (versions.json, served only at the unversioned path, aside), so a client that starts there never leaves it, and nothing under it changes once the release is tagged. The unversioned `/api/` paths are unchanged and always equal the newest release (the `latest` alias).
- Added: `/api/versions.json` (schema `versions`), the list of every release, newest first: version, date, status (`latest` or `superseded`), schema_version, data_version, base_url, tag, release page and changelog. Release 2.0.0 predates the layout and is not regenerated: `/api/2.0.0/` holds the files of its tag byte for byte, with only their own addresses rewritten into the copy (scripts/host_release.py derives it and the release check re-derives it).
- Added to index.json: `tree` (`release` in a frozen copy, `latest` in the alias), `release_base_url` (the frozen copy of `versions.release`; equal to `base_url` inside that copy) and `versions_url`. In a frozen copy `base_url` and `fallback_base_url` name that copy, and `release.base_url` (the raw files at the release tag) now ends in the release number; paths below it are unchanged.
- Added: Cases F to M, thirteen cases in all (the `case_ids` of index.json): their cases.json entries, `cases/{id}.json`, points, approach flow, geometry (STL) and validation documents, and `pairs` files for the runs that exist. Every case has at least one scored run; an engine that has none for a case is `pending` there. `cases.json` and `validation.json` list thirteen cases (the schemas fixed the length at five).
- Added: the point table's columns of schema 2.0.0 (the cleaned release) are served in `points.json` and `points.csv`: `campaign` and `run`, `uv` `uw` `vw`, `C` `c_rms` `concentration_ratio`, `T` `T_rms`, `uc` `vc` `wc`, `uT` `vT` `wT`, `velocity_ratio_sd` and `k_ratio`; `instrument` takes the new values `cup_anemometer`, `sonic_anemometer`, `ldv`, `hydrocarbon_analyser` and `sorbent_gc_ecd`. A document lists only the columns a case has.
- Added: four engines, `openfoam12-kEpsilon` and `openfoam12-kOmegaSST`, which exist for Case I only (the closures other than realizable k-epsilon, solved on one mesh), and `umf-realizableKE` and `umf-buoyantKEpsilon`, Eddy3D's buoyant microclimate engine (urbanMicroclimateFoam, an OpenFOAM 12 solver) under its two closures, which exist for Cases J and L (`umf-buoyantKEpsilon` for J only). `engines` in `cases.json` and `cases/{id}.json` lists an engine only for the cases it applies to.
- Added to each result of validation.json: `notes`, a list of the caveats that come with the run (what the model leaves out, what the measurement cannot say, how the solve ended); empty where the run has none recorded. Cases F, G and M have several runs on one engine (Case F: one per vertical frame, Case G: one per arm of a drag sweep, Case M: one per turbulent Schmidt number, each as `configuration`), all sharing the engine's pairs file; the first column of Case F's and Case G's names the frame or the arm, and Case M's holds the three Schmidt numbers as columns.

### 2.2.0 (2026-10-18)

- Added: `versions.release`, the semantic version of the published data and API (the repository's VERSION; tag vX.Y.Z; rules in CHANGELOG.md), and `release` with its date, tag, release page and `base_url`, the raw files of exactly that release (the tag never moves). `schema_version` stays the version of this JSON contract.

### 2.1.0 (2026-10-15)

- Correction: index.json gave each templated endpoint (cases/{id}.json, schemas/{name}.schema.json, ...) its URI template under `url`, which is not a URL and answered 404 when followed. A templated endpoint now says `templated: true` and lists every concrete file under `urls`; `url` is given only for single-file endpoints, and no URL anywhere contains a brace. llms.txt lists the concrete files the same way.

### 2.0.0 (2026-10-15)

- Breaking: cases/{id}.json `gotchas` is renamed `known_issues`.
- Breaking: `licence` is replaced by `license`, the SPDX identifier CC-BY-4.0; index.json `licence_detail` is `license_detail`.
- Breaking: `generated_from` and `generated_at` are removed. `data_version`, a SHA-256 over every served measurement, geometry and score file, changes when, and only when, the data does; the build is reproducible byte for byte.
- Breaking: links to JSON resources are named `url` (was `file`, `endpoint`, `endpoint_json`); file downloads are objects with `url`, `path`, `media_type`, `bytes` and `sha256` (points `csv`, approach-flow `csv`, run `pairs`, geometry files, the archive, and every entry of index.json `files`).
- Breaking: a validation result's `figures` is a list of {url, caption}.
- Added: validation.json, every case and engine in one table with each run's headline scores.
- Added: cases/{id}/pairs/{engine}.csv, the per-point measured and modelled values behind every scored run, so any score can be recomputed; linked from each result as `pairs`.
- Added: cases/{id}/approach_flow.csv, the measured approach-flow profile in SI units.
- Added: schemas/{name}.schema.json, the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of every document, named by its `$schema` and embedded in openapi.json.
- Added: `run_id` on every validation result; geometry renders and captions in geometry.json.
- Added: download URLs carry `?v=<SHA-256 prefix>`, so a changed file has a new URL and no cache serves a stale copy.
- Added: /llms.txt at the site root, and schema.org Dataset metadata on the home page.

### 1.0.0 (2026-10-14)

- First release.
